## History

Anderson served as a crew member aboard the [Scotia](../codex/tech.md#scotia) during the period when a mysterious, massive sea creature began terrorizing global shipping lanes. Following a violent collision that caused significant damage to the vessel, he became part of the public outcry demanding the creature's removal. This event marked his direct involvement in the escalating international crisis surrounding the unidentified marine phenomenon.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017)_
